Contract.title: Reject an empty export destination
Contract.Problem: Export accepts an empty destination and attempts to write instead of failing validation. The focused regression test for this case exists and is red at the start revision.
Contract.Change: An empty export destination is rejected with the existing validation error, and no file is written.

Constraints.Constraint: Exports to a valid destination behave as before, including the current filename behaviour: the file is written into the destination directory as export-YYYY-MM-DD.csv, dated in UTC, and replaces an existing file of that name.
The rejection reuses the existing validation error; no new error type or message is introduced.

NonGoals.NonGoal: The public API of the export module.

Acceptance.Criterion: An empty destination produces the validation error and writes no file.
Valid destinations still export, under the filename K1 states.
